title: SMART Guidelines KG L2-DMN classes
description: The classes a L2-DMN knowledge-graph node can be. smart-base document kinds and extractions name them as `sgkg-l2-dmn#<code>`. GENERATED by smart-base/L1/schemas/emit.ts from smart-base/L2-dmn/schemas/l2-dmn.ts: do not hand-edit; change the layer source and run `npm run build` in smart-base/L1/schemas/.

source.note: smart-base/L2-dmn/schemas/l2-dmn.ts, the layer's `classes`: id, name, note and iri.

codes.label: DMN File
codes.definition: One DMN file as a unit -- the `dmn:definitions` root. Shares its IRI with the l1:external-artifact for the same file, so the l2:decision-support-logic component that points at it and this subgraph name one resource.

codes.label: DMN Decision
codes.definition: A `dmn:decision` -- the question being answered, and the node that carries the link back to the BPMN task invoking it. A file may hold several; the BCG file holds one.

codes.label: DMN Decision Table
codes.definition: The table realising a decision. Separate from dmn-decision because DMN permits other expression kinds -- a literal expression, an invocation -- and collapsing the two would make the graph unable to say which was used.

codes.label: DMN Input Clause
codes.definition: An input column. Its expression text is where data element names are embedded, which is the only reason this is a node rather than a property of the table.

codes.label: DMN Output Clause
codes.definition: An output column. The BCG table's four are Care Plan, Guidance displayed to health worker, Annotations and Reference(s). These are column DEFINITIONS in a decision table, not clinical records: no edge from this class reaches an execution artefact, and none may.

codes.label: DMN Rule
codes.definition: One row. Its input and output cells are carried as properties, not nodes: 250 of them in the BCG table alone, none the target of a cross-model edge. What the rule needs a node for is its citation edge into L1.
